We provide full-cycle bookkeeping and integrated accounting services for growing businesses, including daily transaction recording, monthly reconciliations, payroll management, accounts payable and receivable, and financial reporting.

About me

Karin Danisova, CPB

Certified Professional Bookkeeper (CPB) · QuickBooks Online Advanced Certified

Running a business can be challenging. I help ease that load by keeping my clients’ interests first and handling their books efficiently, professionally, discreetly and accurately. Since 2005, I have worked as a freelance bookkeeper and in accounting firms in the GTA. That experience has equipped me to support different types of businesses.

I grew up in Slovakia and hoped to play handball professionally. I moved to Canada, where I built a career, a family, lasting friendships and a business I am proud of.

Outside work, I spend time with my two kids, walk my dog, paddleboard, play with Handball Club Toronto and work on my golf game. You might find me at the lake, on the handball court, at the driving range or wherever my kids happen to be.

Sport taught me discipline, teamwork and dedication. I bring that same commitment, reliability and personal attention to my clients.

Process automation

We automate digital receipt capture, invoice processing, transaction categorization and account reconciliation. A bookkeeping professional reviews every automated step for accuracy. You can access current accounting records from anywhere, on any device.

Fixed monthly rate

Our fixed monthly rate helps you budget with predictable costs and consistent support. Packages are tailored to your business and include access to current financial information and tax-ready records.

Committed to excellence

Why us

Trust matters when you choose someone to look after your finances. Check qualifications and references, and look for someone who can handle your books professionally, discreetly and accurately.

As a Certified Professional Bookkeeper and QuickBooks Online Advanced Certified ProAdvisor, Karin brings professional training and attention to detail to ongoing bookkeeping and QuickBooks Online support. We aim to keep your records accurate, current and useful so you can focus on your business.
